messages:
rishi: Quick thread to pick scope for the observability console slice we talked about yesterday. Customers asked for: route-level spend, trace links, and better error grouping. I'm proposing a lean "Link" scope (dashboards + trace hook + grouped errors) as our Q2 target.

jana: +1 to Link. It hits the 80% use-cases and avoids the full billing infra hit. We should call out explicit launch criteria though.

ben: proposed launch criteria: 1) dashboards deployed to prod, 2) cost widget showing route+model breakdown with confidence band, 3) trace hook API documented and SDK example, 4) error grouping reduces alert noise by >=50% in canary.

claire: telemetry guardrails: default sampling 0.5% global, Dedicated customers can enable up to 5% via UI. UI must show "Estimated token increase" before toggling.

rishi: good. runtime change required: emit per-request meta: {route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out} and attach span-id header when sampled. Pseudocode: ```if(sampled){ headers['x-rw-span']=spanId; emit('trace.forward',{route}) }```

jana: for cost attribution we can start with nightly aggregation and label it "best-effort". show a confidence interval in the widget. Keep retention of raw request telemetry to 7d to limit cost.

ben: canary plan: 4 customers (2 PLG, 1 growth, 1 Dedicated) for 10 days. Monitors: token delta, dashboard query latency, error-group false positives. Abort if token delta > 35% or p95 latency > 250ms.

claire: dev estimates: telemetry schema (1d), trace hook + SDK snippet (2d), cost aggregation + dashboard (3d), error grouping heuristics (2d). Parallelized ~8 engineer-days.

rishi: owners: Product: rishi, Runtime: ben, Platform: jana, Docs: claire. Deploy-bot will own canary alerts. Action: ben open telemetry PR today; jana create dashboard tickets; claire draft UI copy. Drop thumbs if you agree.

jana: :thumbsup:

ben: :thumbsup:

claire: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CANARY SCHEDULED: start=1728210000 duration=10d. Will post status and token deltas.

rishi: thanks all. I'll update roadmap slice and add launch criteria to the release doc. Parking lot: per-tenant billing UI and full-span viewer for later releases.
